dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, hello. I'm not doing anything, really, just sitting here, thinking about things...

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: For example, the acolyte exams are coming up and I've hardly prepared... It's not easy to memorize every prayer that every Moonchanter has ever recorded.

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: However, even if I don't pass, I can keep on being a regular follower, and everything will stay as peaceful and quiet as it is now — it doesn't sound all that bad, really. In fact, it sounds pretty great.
